name: fastbillings
description: FastBillings monorepo — API, tenant app, platform admin

scripts.dev: npm run kill-ports && concurrently -n api,tenant,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix fastbillings-backend && npm run lint --prefix fastbillings-frontend && npm run lint --prefix fastbillings-admin
